# json11 (demo-only dependency)

Unmodified `json11.hpp`, `json11.cpp` and `LICENSE.txt` from [dropbox/json11](https://github.com/dropbox/json11), commit `2df9473fb3605980db55ecddf34392a2e832ad35` (MIT, Copyright 2013 Dropbox, Inc.).

Only the Windows `map_online_win32` example links this C++11 library for TileJSON parsing. The CUI C99 core, amalgamation and offline gallery do not use it. Keep the upstream license when distributing the example.
